summary: Iteration 3 (AI Tutor + Leaderboard) PASSES. Backend: 7/7 new tests green against public preview (tutor message, context follow-up, conversation list, detail, delete, leaderboard all + week). Frontend (mobile 390x844): home -> tutor-button -> tutor-welcome with 4 suggestions, clicking tutor-suggestion-0 renders tutor-msg-0 (user) then tutor-msg-1 (assistant) in Bahasa Indonesia (~8-15s latency, confirmed Indonesian markers + analogi + no full code dump). tutor-history-button -> /tutor/history lists 3 tutor-conv-* with tutor-delete-* buttons and tutor-new-chat returns to empty welcome. Leaderboard: /leaderboard shows leaderboard-my-rank, Rank #1 QA 105 XP masked as 'QA S.' with is_me=true (kamu), 'Minggu ini' pill switches scope without error, bottom 'Lihat All-time/Minggu ini' toggle also flips scope. Profile menu: profile-tutor -> /tutor, profile-leaderboard -> /leaderboard both navigate correctly. Regression (iter-2 flows) implicit via login + navigation reused. Deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not present in server/UI code reviewed.

issues: Input row and send button meet 44pt target (inputRow paddingBottom uses insets.bottom + 10 so chat input sits above home indicator). KeyboardAvoidingView present for iOS. OK.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py tutor_message does a dead-branch LlmChat replay with 'break' then throws it away before building the fresh_chat — the first LlmChat call is pure overhead and silently swallowed on exception; recommend removing the first chat block to save tokens/latency (saves ~1 LLM round-trip of risk).
Context injection in tutor_message inlines last 8 turns verbatim without token budgeting — long conversations could exceed Claude context eventually; consider trimming to a char/token cap.
Weekly leaderboard uses ISO string compare on updated_at >= week_ago which works because now_iso() stores timezone-aware ISO; mix with naive strings would break. Current code is consistent — OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (tutor chat, history, new-chat, leaderboard all+week+bottom-toggle, profile shortcuts)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing QA user; 3 pre-existing tutor conversations observed and left intact (one new conversation created by first-message test was deleted by test_tutor_delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tutor_leaderboard.py validates tutor+leaderboard. Tutor LLM latency ~8-15s so UI tests must wait >=30s for tutor-msg-1. Leaderboard masked name format: 'First L.' (two chars with dot) or single word; is_me entry present for QA. Weekly scope may be empty for fresh DBs — treat tutor-leaderboard-empty as valid.
